text:
Lina Gomez: Quick thread: small-button visual weight on dense data tables. We're getting PM feedback that actions feel lost. Thoughts on adding a subtle outline or increasing min-width?
Rory Chen: I've tried 2 approaches in the playground: 1) 1px outline with 0.04 alpha black, 2) increase horizontal padding from 6px to 10px. Outline helps on pale surfaces.
Priya Nair: Outline looks fine, but on dark surfaces it becomes noisy. Maybe we conditionally apply outline based on surface tone token `--surface-contrast-level`?
Ben Holt: Or use a semantic token `--button-border-visible` that toggles between none/outline depending on density. Less CSS calc logic in components.
Lina Gomez: I like `--button-border-visible`. Default false, set true in dense table rows. Also let's bump focus ring contrast for small buttons.
Rory Chen: I'll prototype `--button-pad-x: 10px` and `--button-border-visible: true` on `.table--dense .btn--small`. Also reduce border-radius to 6px for small buttons to feel compact.
Priya Nair: Copy micro: small buttons often say "Run" vs "Start". Product suggested standardizing to "Run" for inline actions. Can we add a copy guide in components docs?
Ben Holt: Yes adding `copy: "Run"` as recommended for inline small action buttons in docs.
Lina Gomez: Accessibility: ensure small buttons meet 44px minimum tap area. If visual is smaller, we still need padding hit area.
Rory Chen: Implementing `.btn--small { min-width: 44px; padding: calc((44px - font-size)/2) ... }` in playground.
Priya Nair: Also a11y nit: remove icon-only small buttons without an aria-label. QA found two instances missing labels.
design-bot: Automated check: component/button small-variant aria-label missing on 2 pages.
Ben Holt: I'll add a docs section "Icon-only buttons must include aria-label" and a lint rule.
Lina Gomez: Action items: Rory add tokens and prototype, Ben add docs + lint, Priya update copy guidance. Aim for the next minor.
Rory Chen: Snippet I will land: 
``n
.table--dense .btn--small { --button-pad-x: 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: var(--button-border-visible) ? 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04) : none; }
.btn--small { min-width: 44px; }
```n
Priya Nair: Adding copy example: `button.inlineAction.default=Run` to i18n.
Ben Holt: I'll wire up the lint rule to fail CI if an icon-only button lacks aria-label.
Lina Gomez: Great. Let's keep the visual subtle so it doesn't compete with primary CTAs. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
